purpose: Teach: 連敗/概観/旧来/番地/大口/取り決め/売り手/融通

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、論文審査で連敗するな
lines.en: Ren — don't keep losing on paper reviews.
lines.style: Firm, measured instruction. Low register, direct. No rush. The weight of experience speaking. Brief pause after his name, acknowledging him before the directive lands.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究分野の概観を論文の序章にまとめました
lines.en: Yes. I've put together an overview of the research field for the introduction.
lines.style: Respectful, careful delivery. Slight formality in the register. Speaking as someone listening intently — wanting to show he's understood and acted. Clear articulation on each task mentioned.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、旧来の研究手法も学習しろ
lines.en: And study the established research methods too, Ren.
lines.style: Steady direction, not harsh. The 'and' carries mild emphasis — another necessary piece he's overlooked. Still mentoring, not reprimanding. A pause before the name, letting it matter.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究室の番地と連絡先を明示します
lines.en: Yes. I'll make sure to include the lab's address and contact information clearly.
lines.style: Formal deference, but genuine — not performing respect, offering it. Quiet and careful. Each element of the task gets equal weight in the delivery.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、大口スポンサーへの提案書も準備しろ
lines.en: Ren — prepare a proposal for the major sponsors too.
lines.style: Another layer of the workload, delivered without apology. Direct but not unkind. The steady accumulation of expectation. Slight firmness on 'prepare', matter-of-fact.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。共同研究の取り決めを論文付録で明示します
lines.en: Yes. I'll clarify the terms of the joint research agreement in the paper appendix.
lines.style: Attentive and precise. Slight pickup in pace — showing he's absorbing each instruction and already planning the execution. Professional tone. Ends with quiet resolve.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、特許市場で売り手の立場を理解しろ
lines.en: Understand what it means to be a seller in the patent market, Ren.
lines.style: Subtle shift in weight — moving toward the strategic, business side of research. Calm, almost philosophical in delivery. His name at the end carries particular attention.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究機材を融通で借用させていただきます
lines.en: Yes. I'll arrange to borrow the research equipment through our networks.
lines.style: Quiet confidence mixed with respect. Small breath before speaking — gathering himself to close the conversation. Measured, professional. Ends with understated finality.
